title: The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, September 17, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, September 17, 2018 Posted by admin on September 17th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP), Microsoft (MSFT), Pfizer (PFE) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -18 points.
Friday the Dow was up +8.68 (+0.03%) at 26,154.67.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.81%.
There were 16 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by United Technologies (UTX) +1.68% and Boeing (BA) +1.22%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Disney (DIS) -1.27% and Apple (AAPL) -1.14%.
UnitedHealth (UNH -0.07%) was rated a new ‘Outperform’ at Cowen with a price target of $308.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.851 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 9/25/2018 after the market close.
